settings.question: What is virtual staging?
settings.answer: Virtual staging digitally furnishes photos of an empty (or cluttered) room so buyers can see it as a home. At Bella, a real interior designer places photorealistic furniture and decor in your listing photos — no truck, no rental furniture, and the result is MLS-ready in 24–48 hours.

settings.question: What is virtual furniture staging?
settings.answer: Studio-produced virtual furniture staging is a premium service that shows a space’s full potential by digitally furnishing it with realistic, well-designed furniture and décor. Unlike traditional staging, which needs physical furniture, logistics and higher costs, it delivers polished, photo-ready results without the hassle, at a fraction of the price.

settings.question: How much does virtual staging cost?
settings.answer: From {price:virtual-staging} per photo, with volume discounts up to 20%: 5% at three photos, 10% at six, 15% at eleven, and 20% at twenty-one.

settings.question: How long does virtual staging take?
settings.answer: 24 to 48 hours from the moment you upload, with unlimited revisions free for two weeks and a rework-or-refund guarantee.

settings.question: When do I send my photos?
settings.answer: After checkout. Your order confirmation includes an upload link, so you can order now and send the photos whenever they're ready — nothing is needed up front.

settings.question: Is virtual staging allowed on the MLS?
settings.answer: Yes. Virtually staged photos are widely used on the MLS as long as they're disclosed as virtually staged. We build every image to MLS specifications and tell you exactly what to note.

settings.question: Can you stage occupied or cluttered rooms?
settings.answer: Yes, at no extra charge. Furniture removal is included free — we digitally clear the existing furniture first, then stage the empty room.

settings.question: What software is used for virtual staging?
settings.answer: Our designers use professional 3D and image-editing software, and every image is composed by hand, never generated by AI, so scale, shadows and light match the room.

settings.question: How much does 3D rendering cost?
settings.answer: At Bella, photoreal renders start at {price:3d-rendering-service-for-architectural-visualization} per finished image — one room or building from one camera angle, with revisions and 4K print-ready delivery included.

settings.question: How long does a 3D render take?
settings.answer: Typical delivery is one to two weeks, depending on project scope. You review a draft and mark up changes, and we revise until it's right.

settings.question: How much does a floor plan cost, and how long does it take?
settings.answer: From {price:2d-3d-floor-plan-service} per floor, delivered in 24 to 48 hours from the moment you send your materials, with revisions included.

settings.question: Does Bella work with clients in the USA and other countries?
settings.answer: Yes, we work with clients internationally. Our virtual staging services are available for properties anywhere in the world.

settings.question: Why should you use Bella?
settings.answer: We provide professional, high-quality virtual staging at competitive prices with fast turnaround times and excellent customer service. Every photo is composed by hand by a professional interior designer.

settings.question: What makes Bella different?
settings.answer: Our attention to detail, quick turnaround, customization options and dedicated customer support set us apart.
